plain: James Lacatski, a government scientist who ran a secret Pentagon UFO program, is said to have stated that the US has a craft not made by humans and that his team got inside it. The program was a Pentagon-funded study of advanced aerospace threats that ran from about 2007 to 2012. Lacatski first said this publicly to the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell and the journalist George Knapp on their podcast, Weaponized. Corbell recalls Lacatski being "allowed to tell us" that the government "has a UFO in its possession and has been able to access the inside of it," kept in an aerospace hangar. A clip of Lacatski answering "Yes" is shown on Michels' show. Jesse Michels repeats the claim several times and ties it to Lacatski's book Skinwalkers at the Pentagon. Some versions say Lacatski went in himself, others say his team did. Eric Davis, a physicist who worked with the program, says he heard it from Lacatski directly, and Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower, says he fully believes it. Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, adds that the craft was empty inside and that the team told members of Congress, with Senator Harry Reid present, around 2011, in a secure room for classified briefings. If true, it would mean the government holds a real non-human craft.
